card.summary: 1 GB file storage on Free; 1 GB/month file egress; 0.5 GB database; 40 deployments

free_tier.stated: 1 GB file storage on Free; 1 GB/month file egress; 0.5 GB database; 40 deployments

egress.terms: 1 GB/month data egress total on Free (serving user files, accessing files in functions, backups). Equal to the storage size, so a full store can be fetched exactly once per month.

record.tooling: Convex client SDKs (JS/Python/Rust), HTTP actions, `npx convex` CLI, `storage.getUrl()` bearer URLs. 'anyone with the URL can access the file' (public, no auth).
record.chaining: Free/Starter is per TEAM; 40 deployments per team on Free. But file storage is 1 GB total per team, not per deployment. So deployments do not multiply storage. Multiple teams/accounts is the only axis. Upload URLs are one-time and short-lived, which makes external tools awkward.
record.limits_note: 1 GB storage AND 1 GB egress; HTTP action responses capped at 100 MiB so you cannot proxy large files; file URLs are unrevocable except by deleting the file.
record.reliability_note: Free has hard resource caps (Starter can exceed with usage-based billing). Well-behaved, no data loss reported; 100 MiB response cap breaks large-file serving via custom routes.

evidence.proved: 'File Storage | Storage: Free: 1 GB total', 'Data egress: Free: 1 GB/month total'
